service_tier_default_sentence: If set to ‘default’, then the request will be processed with the standard pricing and performance for the selected model.
service_tier_auto_sentence: If set to ‘auto’, then the request will be processed with the service tier configured in the Project settings.
service_tier_omitted_sentence: When not set, the default behavior is ‘auto’.
project_fast_default_sentence: Requests that don’t specify a service_tier then default to Fast mode.

caching_default_sentence: Prompt caching is enabled by default for supported OpenAI models.
